meta_title: JMT Decorating Services | Painter & Decorator Leicester
meta_description: JMT Decorating Services in Leicester. Professional interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Free quotes. Call 07775 524518 today.
hero_eyebrow: Professional Painter & Decorator — Over 15 Years' Experience
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert interior and exterior painting. Free quotes, no mess, finished on time.
services_subhead: From interior walls and woodwork to exterior masonry and render — we handle every decorating task with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Full redecoration of living spaces, bedrooms, kitchens, and bathrooms. We prepare, prime, and paint to a finish that lasts — all dust sheets and protection included.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Weatherproofing
services.desc: Protect your home's exterior with quality paint and sealants. Fascias, soffits, woodwork, and rendered walls — all colour-matched to your taste.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Precise hanging and pattern matching on any wall. We strip old paper, prepare surfaces, and hang your choice of pattern or texture.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting, architraves, and built-ins painted to a smooth, durable finish. Undercoat and gloss applied for a professional result.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Tiling Paint
services.desc: Specialist tile paint and primer for kitchens and bathrooms. Transforms existing tiles without grout replacement — moisture-resistant and durable.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial Decorating
services.desc: Schools, offices, retail units, and factories. We work to schedule, minimise disruption, and leave spaces ready to use.

about_pullquote: I started this to do the job properly — no shortcuts, no surprises, fair price.
about_para_1: JMT Decorating Services was founded over 15 years ago on a simple principle: do every job as if it's your own home. Based in Rothley, Leicester, we've built a reputation for meticulous preparation, colour advice, and finishing work that homeowners and businesses trust. We're still owner-run, and that hands-on approach means you always get consistency and care.
about_para_2: Customers choose us because we listen — we don't oversell or rush through a job. We turn up on time, protect your furniture and floors, and clean up properly afterwards. Repeat bookings and word-of-mouth recommendations make up most of our work, which tells you everything about our standards and reliability.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About JMT Decorating

reviews.text: Had our lounge and hallway done. John turned up on time, protected everything, and the finish is immaculate. Brilliant attention to detail — you can tell he takes pride in his work. Would definitely have him back.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Needed our kitchen and bathroom refreshed. Not only did JMT do a professional job, but he also advised on colours and finishes without trying to upsell. Fair pricing and no hidden costs. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Susan K.

reviews.text: Exterior woodwork and fascias needed repainting before winter. John completed it in two days, matched the existing colour perfectly, and left zero mess. That's the standard we should expect — and that's what you get here.
reviews.author: David L.
